name: redfort-platform
description: RedFort Tech platform monorepo: public website, CMS admin panel, and REST API.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/web && npm install --prefix apps/cms
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run db:seed:content
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web && npm run build:cms
scripts.lint: npm run --prefix apps/api lint && npm run --prefix apps/web lint && npm run --prefix apps/cms lint
scripts.typecheck: npm run --prefix apps/web typecheck && npm run --prefix apps/cms typecheck
